semantics.rule_fires: ALL patterns of the rule must match somewhere in the text
semantics.order: RESERVED first in listed order, then AMBIGUOUS; first firing rule wins and is reported as the cause
semantics.buckets: no reserved/ambiguous match + recommendation -> internal_reversible; no match + no recommendation -> no_recommendation
semantics.sibling_rule: a card is also held when ANY other pending card on the same issue is held — server-side only, needs the issue's other cards
semantics.dialect_warning: Python \b is Unicode-aware, JS \b is ASCII-only. Do not assume parity — run the conformance suite in the consuming language.
